lessons.title: Best current weighting
lessons.body: Hard-Course Guard graded best across the walk-forward sample at 7.4 projected top-20 hits per event.

lessons.title: Weighting change signal
lessons.body: Compared with Balanced Lab, Hard-Course Guard gained +0.18 top-20 hits per event and reduced missed-cut leakage by 0.17 projected top-20 players per event.

lessons.title: Fit + form test
lessons.body: Heavier recent-form and same-course weighting gained +0.03 top-20 hits per event and reduced missed-cut leakage by 0.12; useful, but not the best overall blend.

lessons.title: Major setup read
lessons.body: For majors, Talent Anchor is the leading blend, which tells us whether championship history and hard-course samples deserve more weight.

lessons.title: Hard-course read
lessons.body: On harder-scoring events, Short-Game Risk led the board; that is the clearest place to test course-fit and short-game upgrades.
